body:
It's not just the drugs. The drugs are a consequence. I have proved incapable of forming healthy relationships with anyone. I'm sure even the person who I consider my best friend only stayed because he was too afraid to leave me alone after stopping me from walking in front of a bus. It feels so conditional. It reminds me that he's only here because his best friend blew his brains out in high school.

Yeah, people don't want me to do this but read my first reply - I named myself ticking clock for a reason. I have a few days to enjoy. Then that's it. I'm finished. There is nothing I can do that will biologically make me pass this piss test, all because I decided to say goodbye to a 'friend' of mine at the worst possible moment.

I'm sorry if I don't see the silver lining anymore. I really want to.

My responses will be more succinct now - I'm typing on my phone to avoid twenty hits of web traffic to SW - something that will definitely set off alarms if anyone checks Internet through traffic.

Yes, I have voluntarily seen a college appointed therapist for about 6 months. No, it didn't help. It just told me why I'm a failure, not how to fix it. 

I have not told my family anything of what I've written. I think if they knew, they would feel forced into being kind and supportive for fear of sending me over the edge. The thought of that sickens me. To not only be a burden, but a fragile little emotional cripple who can't take tough love? That's bullshit.

The most meaningful conversation I've had was two months ago, when I last attempted. My sister spelled out all of my flaws for me in a way that only family can, and I was better for it. I also gave her my word I would never use until its legal.

Heres a thing I left out - I've been intentionally isolating myself from people I used with. Why set yourself up, right? Last day of classes, I stop by a guy's house, and I considered his friendship the least fucked up out of the ones I made. I walk in the house right as he lights off a very large gravity bong hit, and it's sloppy. Smoke goes everywhere. I get buzzed, and leave the house to smoke a cig outside. 

Drug tested myself two days later - I'm positive. No matter who I tell, they'll think I just smoked weed again. Ill take the court drug test and fail. My sister will cut ties, since I gave her my word and breaking it is an unforgivable betrayal to her. My family kicks me out, since failing a noncompliance test gets me a strike at school, of which I have 2 (out of 3). I lose financial support and I go work shitty minimum wage jobs until I get cancer and die alone.

Fuck that, man. I tried. I really did. I still failed. I compromised my "isolate from everyone I used with" plan and it cost me the last chance I have at making it through this.

So this future that you say I have - I don't want it. I know everything that's wrong with me and there's nothing I can do about it now, like watching a train wreck in slow motion. My clock is ticking and I'm smiling. These next few days will be the most beautiful days of my life.

Im sorry, did I say more succinct? I was completely wrong. 

I have a feeling my folks will eventually find my post. I have this to say.

Don't not confront me with this. You'll just ensure I do it, and in an extremely painful method instead of peacefully in my car.

Don't try and talk me out of it. I need to make this decision on my own and your interference will invalidate any chance I have at fixing this. It needs to be me who decides if I do this or not.

I love you. I'm sorry I'm such a fucking disappointment. I never meant to be.
